description: Extract reusable agent skills, refine workflows from execution evidence, recover specifications, and validate agent evaluation methods.

defaultPrompts: Extract reusable agent skills from this completed project.

requirements: Blind reconstruction and delegated work need a host with isolated agents or tasks.
Scheduling needs host automation support. Plugins do not add model, tool, or automation access.
Optional skill-authoring and empirical-tuning tools are discovered from the host and are not bundled.
